Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “older director” as “older at the time of each film’s release” and instructed to compute Age_at_release (release year − birth year). This wrong metric would incorrectly favor The Girl King (Mika Kaurismäki age ~60 in 2015) over Happy as the Grass Was Green (Charles Davis age ~48 in 1973), even though Charles Davis (born 1925) is the older person overall compared to Mika Kaurismäki (born 1955).
